senses.gloss:
Ulkā regularly denotes a meteor from the Rigveda onwards. In the Brāhmaṇas it also signifies a ‘firebrand.’ The much rarer form Ulkuṣī has both senses.
Foot notes iv. 4, 2; x. 68, 4; Av. xix. 9, 8, Ṣaḍviṃśa brāhmaṇa, vi. 8, etc.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, v. 5, 4, 19.
As ‘meteor,’ Av. v. 17, 4; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, xi. 2, 7, 21; as ‘firebrand,’ ibid., iii. 9, 2, 9.
